sloka: ततो दाशरथी राम उवाच शिलोच्चयम् ।मम बाण अग्नि निर्दग्धो भस्मी भूतो भविष्यसि ॥३-६४-३३॥
transliteration: tato dāśarathī rāma uvāca śiloccayam ।mama bāṇa agni nirdagdho bhasmī bhūto bhaviṣyasi ॥3-64-33॥

translations.english: Rama, Dasaratha's son said to the mountain, The fire of my arrows will reduce you to ashes.You will have no grass, no tree, no twig. You will be unfit to be served any more.
